props.title: Immortals

sections.content: Immortals (2011) represents Tarsem Singh's visually audacious take on Greek mythology, following in the testosterone-laden footsteps of 300 (2006) but with a distinctly more baroque visual style. The film's hyperkinetic approach to ancient mythology shares DNA with Clash of the Titans (2010), but Singh's background in music videos and surrealist cinema (The Cell (2000)) brings a unique aesthetic that blends golden-hour cinematography with stylized violence. Like Troy (2004), it takes significant liberties with classical mythology, but its visual ambition sets it apart.

sections.content: The film's artistic direction draws heavily from Renaissance paintings, particularly Caravaggio's work, creating tableaux that feel more like moving art installations than traditional action sequences. This approach echoes Singh's earlier work in The Fall (2006), where reality and mythology blur into spectacular imagery. Henry Cavill's portrayal of Theseus established his action credentials years before Man of Steel (2013), though here he's working with a more stylized, operatic type of heroism.

The film's influence can be seen in later mythological adaptations like Gods of Egypt (2016) and Hercules (2014), though neither achieved the same level of visual distinction. Singh's approach to violence - both balletic and brutal - created a template for mythological action that influenced films like Wrath of the Titans (2012) and aspects of Wonder Woman (2017)'s Themyscira sequences. sections.content: Immortals marked a significant shift in how ancient mythology could be visualized on screen. While previous films like Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief (2010) took a more conventional approach, Singh's film embraced digital technology to create impossible architectures and supernatural battles that felt both ancient and futuristic. This visual language influenced later films like God of War (2017) and aspects of Thor: Ragnarok (2017), where mythological elements are treated with similar stylistic boldness.
